services.connector.grimmory.description: Your books and audiobooks library, and the reading sessions.
services.connector.grimmory.help: Use a Grimmory account (an administrator to list members). Its reading sessions are followed; connect one service per reader to follow.
services.connector.jellyfin.description: Your Jellyfin (or Emby) server: films, series, music and what is playing.
services.connector.jellyfin.help: Create a key in Jellyfin: Dashboard → API Keys → +, name it “Portalab”.
services.connector.plex.description: Your Plex Media Server: films, series, music and what is playing.
services.connector.plex.help: In Plex Web, open any film → ⋯ → Get Info → View XML: copy the value after “X-Plex-Token=” in the address bar.
services.connector.radarr.description: The films Radarr follows, and whether they are downloaded.
services.connector.radarr.help: In Radarr: Settings → General → Security → API Key.
services.connector.romm.description: Your retro games library: every game, its platform and its cover.
services.connector.romm.help: Use a RomM account — ideally a dedicated read-only (viewer) account.
services.connector.seerr.description: Overseerr or Jellyseerr: members request a film or a series from the portal.
services.connector.seerr.help: In Seerr: Settings → General → API Key.
services.connector.sonarr.description: The series Sonarr follows, season by season.
services.connector.sonarr.help: In Sonarr: Settings → General → Security → API Key.
services.connector.tautulli.description: Plex watch statistics: films, series, live TV and music, per member.
services.connector.tautulli.help: API key: Tautulli → Settings → Web Interface → API (enable the API, then copy the key).
services.connector.tmdb.description: Rich film and series details: backdrop, cast, saga, budget, box office, genres…
services.connector.tmdb.help: Create a free key on themoviedb.org → Settings → API, then paste the « API Read Access Token » (or the v3 key).
